Form filled from address tokens plus synthetic name/birthdate, email from the login token; the emailed code was put in the field and the Cloudflare Turnstile on the code step was handed off; the account owner solved it and submitted (handoff outcome solved, 64 s), and IKEA's welcome email arrived. A fresh session then signed in at /us/en/profile/login/ with a new emailed code, supplied by the account owner, and reached the signed-in page (logout link, purchase history; get_session_outcome success).
gotchas: US IKEA Family signup: /us/en/profile/signup/ redirects to us.accounts.ikea.com. One page: first/last name, birthdate (MM/DD/YYYY text box), address, preferred store (optional), email, marketing and terms checkboxes. There's no password; IKEA accounts sign in with an emailed one-time code.

The address field starts as an autocomplete search box; click text=Enter address manually to show street/city/zip/state (the street is the second input[name*=address i]). button:has-text(...) doesn't match that control.

Tick the terms checkbox (input[name*=terms i][type=checkbox], force click), then 'Continue to email verification' sends a 6-digit code from no.reply@ikea.com, valid 5 minutes. The code is supplied by the account owner and goes into input[autocomplete="one-time-code"].

A Cloudflare Turnstile widget (iframe[src*="challenges.cloudflare.com"]) is on the code step; submitting the code at signup was held by it through the proxy. That's a captcha owner step: hand it off with the code already in the field; the owner clears Turnstile and presses Continue. A welcome email ('Make the most of your rewards and benefits!') confirms the account.
2026-10-09: the identity first/last-name tokens reported a fill but left the boxes empty ('Your First name is required'), so a synthetic name was typed; check the owner's Identity page has a name.

Sign in: /us/en/profile/login/ → input[type=email] → Continue → code in input[autocomplete="one-time-code"] + Enter. Signed in shows a[href*=logout] and purchase history. The fresh sign-in on 2026-10-09 passed without a Turnstile hold.
